text:
A car, travelling on a straight horizontal road, has 1.6MJ of kinetic energy. It accelerates for 20s
until it has 2.5MJ of kinetic energy.
What is the average power output used to increase the kinetic energy of the car?
A
45W
B
205W
C
45kW
D
205kW
subject: Physics
